observations: Elk uses atomic units unless explicitly stated otherwise.
The atomic unit of energy is Hartree.
reciplat constructs bvec with an explicit 2*pi factor.
Task 102 writes ngridk+1 dimensions and loops periodic endpoints with modulo indexing.
Collinear spin-polarized output is FERMISURF_UP.bxsf and FERMISURF_DN.bxsf.
Reader requires exactly one band per BXSF.
Reader documents reciprocal vectors as a.u.^-1 without 2*pi.
Reader documents energies/Fermi energy in Rydberg convention.
Periodic corner equality is warning-only in this Python port.

declared_adapter_transforms: split each Elk multi-band spin BXSF into single-band BXSF files
remove the duplicated +1 periodic endpoint on all three grid axes
multiply Elk Hartree energies by 2 to obtain Rydberg
divide Elk bvec by 2*pi to remove Elk's reciprocal-lattice 2*pi factor
claim_boundary: The unit/layout transform contract is supported by Elk documentation, pinned PySKEAF source semantics, and a synthetic cross-check. Real CrSb Elk output must still be transformed and independently validated before QO extraction.
